description:
Komodo Go is an independent mobile client for the Komodo infrastructure management platform (komo.do). Monitor and manage your self-hosted servers, Docker containers, stacks, deployments, builds, repositories, and automation from iPhone or iPad.

Connect to your Komodo instance with API credentials, or explore the built-in demo before adding a server.

Use Komodo Go to:

• See server health, CPU, memory, disk, and container activity in a focused dashboard
• Browse servers, containers, stacks, deployments, builds, and repositories
• Start, stop, restart, pause, and redeploy workloads
• Inspect container, stack, deployment, and build logs
• Review alerts, procedures, actions, syncs, providers, tags, and variables
• Manage multiple Komodo connections and app preferences

Designed for self-hosted infrastructure, DevOps monitoring, Docker management, and remote operations, Komodo Go helps you check status and respond without opening the full web interface.

Requires access to a self-hosted or hosted Komodo instance. Feature availability depends on your Komodo version and permissions.

Komodo Go is a third-party app and is not affiliated with the Komodo project. It covers many common workflows but is not feature-complete compared with the Komodo web UI.
promotionalText: Create and manage more Komodo resources from anywhere, with batch operations, richer monitoring, searchable logs, and detailed update controls.
whatsNew:
Manage more of your Komodo environment from your phone, with resource creation, batch operations, deeper monitoring, and searchable logs.

New
• Create stacks, deployments, servers, actions, and procedures from templates, copies, or full forms.
• Copy, rename, delete, and edit metadata or tags for supported resources.
• Run batch operations and see a separate result for each resource.
• Review resource sync plans and file changes before applying updates.
• Search server and container logs with reusable filters.

Improved
• Monitor server health, processes, CPU, memory, disk, and network activity with adjustable intervals.
• See resource health and active work in the Ops Pulse dashboard.
• Check for image updates, inspect execution output, and use expanded container controls.
• Enjoy clearer labels and controls in dark mode.

Fixed
• Code editors and resource names preserve exactly what you type, without unwanted iOS text substitutions.
• Action feedback distinguishes submitted requests from completed results and reports failures correctly.
• Resource statuses refresh more reliably after deployments, stops, and restarts.

Requires iOS 15 or later. Some operations depend on your Komodo version and permissions.
